title: Community
lede: Join the NucleoOS Discord: ask questions, show what you built, get release news first.
bot.title: Quick answers
bot.text: In the server, type /ask and your question, or /guide for short guides.
help.title: Need help?
help.text: Open a post in the help forum: one problem per post, with your board and firmware version.
rules.title: Be kind, stay safe
rules.text: Never post passwords, API keys or Wi-Fi details. No ROMs or pirated files.
